pages./faq/: CHROMABIT HOME PVP STORE AUCTIONS FAQ HELP CENTER HAVEQUESTIONS? Everything you need to know about Chromabit. CHECKING... SERVER IP play.chromabit.us COPY IP VISIT STORE JOIN 60+ PLAYERS ON DISCORD QUESTIONS FAQ JOINING What is the server address?+ play.chromabit.us for Java Edition. Bedrock Edition uses the same address with port 19132. There is no whitelist and no application. Can I play on Bedrock, phone or console?+ Yes. More than half of the players connect from Bedrock. Add a server in Bedrock with address play.chromabit.us and port 19132. Your name appears in game with a dot in front of it, and you use that dotted name in the store too. Which Minecraft version do I need?+ Any Java version up to 26.3 connects, and older releases work too, so you do not have to update or downgrade to play. Bedrock players always connect on their current version. Is there voice chat?+ Yes, through the Simple Voice Chat mod on Java. It is optional and works without it installed. PVP What is ChromaPVP?+ ChromaPVP is the network's kit PVP server. Join play.chromabit.us and pick Kit PVP in the hub. It has ranked and unranked duels, the FFA pit, the Prismatic Arena and tournaments. How does ranked work?+ Play 10 placement matches on a kit to get a rank. Ranked duels are best of three. There are seven tiers, from Tin to Chroma, with three divisions in every tier below Chroma. Ranked opens at level 2. Can Bedrock players play ranked?+ Yes. Java and Bedrock players queue into the same matches and share one ladder. Which kits are ranked?+ Sword and Mace. Where are the leaderboards?+ On the PVP page of this site, and in game with /leaderboard. What happens when a season ends?+ Each season has its own ladder. When a new season starts, everyone plays placement matches again. GAMEPLAY What kind of server is Chromabit?+ Chromabit is a network with two servers behind one address: a survival server with a player-run economy, and ChromaPVP, a ranked kit PVP server. On the SMP, the difficulty is Hard, PvP is on in the wild, and the market is where most of the game happens: you earn by mining, farming spawners and trading, and spend on land, gear and rank. What should I do first?+ Run /rtp to leave spawn, /sethome where you land, then /kit claim for a golden shovel and claim your land. Sell what you gathered with /sell, and open /kit starter for gear, food and two crate keys. /help in game walks you through it. How do spawners work?+ Mine any spawner without Silk Touch and carry it with you. Up to 64 of the same kind stack into one block. Drops collect inside the spawner instead of on the floor; right-click to open its storage, or put an upgradeable hopper under it. Spawners come from /shop, from ranking up, and from the Spawner Crate. What happens when I die?+ You lose 0.5% of your balance (0.1%, capped at $100,000, in the dungeon) and drop your inventory, except Chromatic and Halloween gear, which always stays with you. Logging out during a fight costs 5% instead. Keep inventory is on at spawn, in the dungeon and in the KOTH arena. Is PvP on?+ On the SMP, PvP is on in the overworld, the Nether and the End, and in the KOTH arena. Off at spawn, inside claims and in the dungeon. A 15-second combat tag blocks /home, /spawn and teleports while you are fighting. ECONOMY AND MARKET How much money do I start with?+ $80,000. There is no upkeep and no tax on holding it. The balance leaderboard in the tab list shows where you stand. What is in the auction house?+ Open /ah for four tabs. The auction house holds buy-now listings, up to 75 per player for seven days each. Orders let you post a buy request. Coinflip plays against the house. Liquidity pools are an exchange for elytra, enchanted golden apples, totems, mending books, fireworks, netherite, iron and diamonds, with futures up to 3x leverage. Live prices and history are on the auctions page. What do listings cost?+ A 5% listing fee with a $100 minimum, and a 2% tax on both the buyer and the seller when it sells. What are Prism Shards?+ A second currency used at /craft, where the Chromatic Arsenal, Shards, Clusters, Prisms and other custom items are made. You earn them from crates, kits and the battle pass. How do Auto Sell Chests work?+ Anything placed in one is sold automatically on a timer, every ten minutes by default and upgradeable down to fifteen seconds, with price multipliers you can level up. Everyone can place two; VIP gets 5, VIP+ 10 and MVP 15. RANKS How do I rank up?+ Type /rankup. Each of the ten free ranks, from Tin to Prismatic, asks for things you do in the game: mobs killed, blocks mined, hours played and a balance you have to hold. Only Adamantine takes money from you; every other rank just checks you have it. Each rank hands out spawners, cash or keys. What do paid ranks give?+ Convenience, not power: more homes, more Auto Sell Chests, more player warps, extra spawner storage pages, more upgradeable hoppers, commands like /back, /hat, /feed and /repair, faster mcMMO, and a daily kit with crate keys and Prism Shards. VIP, VIP+, MVP and MVP+ each include everything below them. The store lists exactly what each one grants. How many homes do I get?+ Three to start. Silver adds one and Adamantine adds another. VIP has 10, VIP+ 15, MVP 20 and MVP+ 25. EVENTS AND CRATES When are the events?+ King of the Hill runs every two hours, on the hour, as long as three players are online, in the Backrooms or the Halloween arena. Envoys drop every hour for ten minutes. A vote party fires every twenty votes. The dungeon at /warp dungeon is open all the time. Seasonal events are announced on Discord. What do I win?+ Rewards are in game: the KOTH winner takes a Reward Key, envoys drop spawners and Reward Keys, vote parties give everyone online a Vote Key, and clearing a dungeon camp drops loot worth up to about $5,000,000 at market prices. What is the battle pass?+ Fifty tiers of daily and weekly quests each season. The free track is on for everyone. The Chroma Pass, sold in the store, adds the premium reward on every tier. Season 3, Octoberbit, runs from 1 October to 4 November 2026 and does not carry over from the season before. How do crates work?+ Crates sit at spawn and open with a matching key: Chroma, Shard, Spawner and the seasonal Halloween crate from the store, plus Reward and Vote crates earned in game. Each crate also has guaranteed milestone rewards after a set number of opens. Every reward in the store crates is listed on that crate's key in the store, by rarity. How do I vote?+ Five sites, each giving a Vote Key every 24 hours: minecraftservers.org, minecraft.buzz, topminecraftservers.org, mc-servers.com and topg.org. CLAIMS AND PROTECTION How do I protect my land?+ With a golden shovel from /kit claim. Right-click two corners to claim the area; nobody else can build, break or open containers inside. You start with 100 claim blocks and earn 100 more for every hour you play, up to 80,000. Extra blocks come from the store and from crates. Do claims expire?+ A claim with only a chest in it expires after 7 days and an unused claim after 14. Everything expires after 40 days without logging in, unless you hold at least 40,000 claim blocks or 10,000 bonus blocks. Can mobs or TNT damage my base?+ Explosions and creeper damage are blocked inside claims, and most mob griefing is blocked across the overworld. Raiding unclaimed land is allowed, so claim before you build. RULES What are the rules?+ No cheating or hacking. No griefing. No lag machines. Keep chat civil. Breaking into a claim counts as griefing. Scamming and teleport traps are not banned but are frowned on. Punishments go from mute to temporary ban to ban; the full list is on Discord. Is there anti-cheat?+ Yes. Movement and combat cheats are caught by GrimAC, and ores are hidden until you reach them so X-ray does not work. pages./privacy/: CHROMABIT HOME PVP STORE AUCTIONS FAQ LEGAL PRIVACY POLICY How Chromabit handles your data on this website. LAST UPDATED AUGUST 10, 2026 This policy covers the website at chromabit.us, operated by Chromabit LLC ("we", "us"). It explains what we collect when you visit, why, and how to make us stop. It does not cover what happens in-game on play.chromabit.us, or on Discord. The short version We use privacy-focused analytics to see how many people visit the site and where they get stuck in the store. We do not record your screen, we do not sell data, we do not run advertising, and we never send your Minecraft username to our analytics provider. Payments are handled entirely by Tebex, and we never see or store your card details. What we collect We use PostHog, an analytics service, to understand how the site is used. On each visit it records: Pages you view on this site, and when The site or link that sent you here (referrer and any campaign tags) Approximate location: country and region, derived from your IP address Device information: browser, operating system, and screen size Store activity: which packages you open, add to a cart, or begin checkout for, and any errors you hit while trying to buy Clicks on page elements, used to spot broken or confusing controls We have session recording switched off. PostHog is capable of replaying a video of your screen; we have deliberately disabled it and do not collect those recordings. Analytics data is processed by PostHog on servers in the United States and is retained according to their standard retention period. We do not combine it with any other information about you. What we do not collect Your Minecraft username. It is stored only in your own browser so you don't have to retype it, and it is sent to Tebex to deliver your purchase. It is never sent to our analytics provider. Payment details. Checkout happens on Tebex's own systems. We never receive your card number, billing address, or PayPal login. Your name, email, or account passwords. This site has no user accounts and no signup. Cookies and local storage PostHog sets a cookie so that repeat visits within a session are counted as one person rather than several. We also use your browser's local storage to remember your Minecraft username and your current shopping cart, so they survive a page refresh. That local storage never leaves your device. You can clear both at any time through your browser's settings for this site. Doing so will empty your cart and make you retype your username. Other services Tebex runs our store and processes all payments. GitHub Pages hosts this website. Google Fonts serves the fonts used on these pages. mcsrvstat.us supplies the live player count. Discord supplies our community member count. mc-heads.net serves the player head images on the PVP pages. It receives a Java player's public UUID in the image address and your IP address like any image host; no Bedrock identifier is sent. Each of these receives your IP address as a normal part of serving you the page, and each has its own privacy policy governing what it does with it. Children Minecraft has a large young audience, and we take that seriously. This site is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. We have disabled session recording partly for this reason. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with information, contact us and we will delete it. If you are under 13, please ask a parent before making a purchase. Your choices You can opt out of analytics entirely by turning on "Do Not Track" or "Global Privacy Control" in your browser, or by using any standard content blocker. We do not attempt to work around blockers. Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete the data we hold, or to object to its processing. Because we collect no names or email addresses, we usually cannot connect analytics data to you personally, but contact us and we will do what we can. Changes If we change this policy we will update the date at the top of this page. Continuing to use the site after a change means you accept the updated policy. Contact Questions about this policy, or a data request? Reach us in the Chromabit Discord and open a ticket. HOMEPVPECONOMY SMPFAQAUCTIONSSTOREDISCORDPRIVACY © 2026 Chromabit LLC · play.chromabit.us
